//: Marketplace catalog. Copy to plugin-registry.json (gitignored) or point GROKBOT2_PLUGIN_REGISTRY at a file or URL. Credentials are ${PLACEHOLDERS} resolved at spawn from the backend environment or .data/secrets/<user>.json — never write a real token here, this file is meant to be shared. Each placeholder becomes a field in the client's setup form; `credentials` only supplies its label and hint. `logoUrl` must be https — the client fetches it in the main process and rejects any other scheme.

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Knowledge graph the agent writes to and recalls from across sessions. No credentials.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Repos, issues, pull requests and code search.

GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.title: Personal access token
GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens. Give it the repo scope.

plugins.name: lark
plugins.description: Messages, docs, sheets, calendar and Base through the Lark OpenAPI.

LARK_APP_ID.title: App ID
LARK_APP_ID.description: open.larksuite.com → your app → Credentials & Basic Info.

LARK_APP_SECRET.title: App Secret
LARK_APP_SECRET.description: Same page as the App ID.

plugins.name: gmail
plugins.description: Read, search, draft and send mail. Sign in once first: npx @gongrzhe/server-gmail-autoauth-mcp auth

GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH.title: OAuth client file
GMAIL_OAUTH_PATH.description: Optional. Path to gcp-oauth.keys.json if it is not in the default place.

GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH.title: Saved credentials file
GMAIL_CREDENTIALS_PATH.description: Optional. Where the one-time sign-in stores its token.

plugins.name: notion
plugins.description: Search, read and write pages and databases. Share the pages your integration may touch with it.

NOTION_TOKEN.title: Integration token
NOTION_TOKEN.description: notion.so/my-integrations → create one, then share the pages it may read with it.

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Drive a real browser: open pages, click, fill forms, read the accessibility tree. No credentials.

plugins.name: n8n
plugins.description: Build and run n8n workflows. Serves node documentation even with no instance configured.

N8N_API_URL.title: n8n URL
N8N_API_URL.description: e.g. http://localhost:5678 — leave empty to browse node docs only.

N8N_API_KEY.title: API key
N8N_API_KEY.description: n8n → Settings → API. Only needed to run workflows.

plugins.name: filesystem
plugins.description: Read and write files under one folder you choose.

GROKBOT2_FS_ROOT.title: Folder the agent may use
GROKBOT2_FS_ROOT.description: One absolute path. The agent can read and write anything under it, and nothing outside.

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Up-to-date API documentation and code examples for public libraries. No credentials.

plugins.name: sequential-thinking
plugins.description: Structured step-by-step reasoning scratchpad for long problems. No credentials.

plugins.name: zernio
plugins.description: Every platform Zernio supports in one row — Bluesky, Threads, Reddit, Pinterest, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Google Business and more, plus the six listed separately.

plugins.name: zernio-facebook
plugins.description: Post to Pages, read comments, pull insights. Runs through your Zernio account — one connector, so adding another platform here reuses the same connection.

plugins.name: zernio-instagram
plugins.description: Publish posts and reels, read comments and insights. Runs through your Zernio account — one connector, so adding another platform here reuses the same connection.

plugins.name: zernio-tiktok
plugins.description: Publish videos and read performance. Runs through your Zernio account — one connector, so adding another platform here reuses the same connection.

plugins.name: zernio-youtube
plugins.description: Upload videos, manage descriptions, read analytics. Runs through your Zernio account — one connector, so adding another platform here reuses the same connection.

plugins.name: zernio-linkedin
plugins.description: Post to a profile or company page, read engagement. Runs through your Zernio account — one connector, so adding another platform here reuses the same connection.

plugins.name: zernio-x
plugins.description: Post, reply, and read metrics. Runs through your Zernio account — one connector, so adding another platform here reuses the same connection.

plugins.name: shopify
plugins.description: Đọc và sửa products, orders, customers, variants của store qua Admin GraphQL API. Cần Admin API access token của một custom app trong store của bạn.

credentials.SHOPIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN: Admin API access token (Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps)
credentials.MYSHOPIFY_DOMAIN: Tên miền store, ví dụ your-store.myshopify.com

plugins.name: zernio-whatsapp
plugins.description: Gửi và đọc tin nhắn WhatsApp Business. Chạy qua tài khoản Zernio — nối thêm nền tảng ở đây dùng lại cùng một kết nối.

plugins.name: zernio-bluesky
plugins.description: Đăng bài và đọc tương tác trên Bluesky. Nối bằng handle + app password ngay trên trang Zernio.

plugins.name: zernio-threads
plugins.description: Đăng bài và đọc tương tác trên Threads. Chạy qua tài khoản Zernio.

plugins.name: zernio-reddit
plugins.description: Đăng bài lên subreddit, đọc comment và điểm. Chạy qua tài khoản Zernio.

plugins.name: zernio-pinterest
plugins.description: Tạo pin, quản lý board, đọc số liệu. Chạy qua tài khoản Zernio.

plugins.name: zernio-discord
plugins.description: Đăng vào channel và đọc tin nhắn. Chạy qua tài khoản Zernio.

plugins.name: zernio-telegram
plugins.description: Đăng vào channel/group Telegram. Nối bằng mã: nhắn Grok "nối Telegram" — nó lấy mã, bạn thêm bot làm admin rồi gửi mã kèm @channel cho bot.
